title: Col. Berry's excavation of Loughgall crannog
description: File of material mostly handwritten but with a 20pp typed transcript of part of it. All concerning Col. Berry's excavation of Loughgall crannog mostly in Berry's hand. C.1920. Also includes a copy of Light, the journal of Spiritual Progress & Psychical Research dated 24 December 1921 which includes a short article about the 'dig' and how it was aided by a spiritual medium. Also three photos of an Orange parade and several negatives which may include some of Loughgall excavation.

title: Early Medieval bone ring
description:
Fragment of a bone ring. The existing arc suggests an external diameter of 42mm and an internal diameter of 28mm, which would be suitable for a finger or toe ring; but the ring itself seems too thick and clumsy for such a purpose.

Similar to that at Llangor Crannog.
